source_snapshot.title: Ras Al Khaimah closes all beaches 'until further notice'
source_snapshot.text: Ras Al Khaimah closed all its beaches "until further notice", according to a notice by the emirate's Public Services Department. The authority did not immediately disclose the reason. The re-opening of the beaches will be announced "in due course," it said. The authority urged the public to comply with guidelines issued by the relevant authorities to ensure everyone's safety. Other emirates have also closed down beaches and coastal areas. On Friday, Sharjah authorities announced that Al Hamriya Beach will be closed temporarily asa precaution after an oil slick in nearby waters. Earlier, the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment confirmed an oil spill off Umm Al Quwain to be the source of the 'fuel-like' smell that residents reported across multiple emirates. All beaches and coastal areas in Umm Al Quwain have been temporarily closed until teams complete assessments, and identify safety and marine protection measures, the ministry said. The odours "pose no health risk" to residents, the ministry confirmed. After the spill was detected, teams immediately began containment, cordoning, cleanup and remediation to limit environmental impact, Moccae said.

title: Ras Al Khaimah closes all beaches 'until further notice'
summary_ru: 🏖 Рас-эль-Хайма закрыла все пляжи до особого распоряжения Все пляжи эмирата Рас-эль-Хайма закрыты до дальнейших уведомлений. Причина не раскрывается, но власти призывают соблюдать рекомендации для безопасности. Похожие меры приняты и в других эмиратах: пляж Аль-Хамрия в Шардже временно закрыт из-за нефтяного пятна, а пляжи в Умм-эль-Кувейне закрыты после разлива нефти. Министерство климата и окружающей среды подтвердило, что запах топлива не представляет угрозы здоровью. Ведутся работы по локализации и очистке загрязнения.
